topic: Gojo's choice not to cremate Geto's body is what let Kenjaku use Geto's face to seal him in Shibuya
title: Gojo's One Choice Gave Kenjaku Geto's Face
description: Gojo didn't lose Shibuya to power. Gojo left Geto's body unburned, and Kenjaku is the one who took it. Do you think Gojo was sealed because of grief?
comment: Was Gojo sealed because he kept Geto's body, or would Kenjaku have found another lure anyway? Pick one.

lines.text: Gojo didn't lose to Kenjaku. He lost to a body he refused to burn.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: At the end of Jujutsu Kaisen 0, Gojo finishes his best friend. Chapter 90 confirms it.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: Then one choice. He doesn't send the body to Jujutsu High to be cremated.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: Gojo left that body unburned, and that's why Kenjaku could take it.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: Kenjaku puts his brain in that skull and gets Geto's memories, face, and Cursed Spirit Manipulation.

shot.search: Kenjaku brain Geto Cursed Spirit Manipulation
shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: He already held the sealing cube, but he can't take Gojo's body. Gojo is unbeatable.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: So he doesn't need power. He needs a face.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: In Shibuya, Gojo turns around, sees Geto, and three years of memories hit him at once.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: That's the one minute the cube needed.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: People say he'd find another lure. But nobody else could make Gojo stop.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: I don't think Gojo lost to power. I think he lost to grief.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: And that grief started the night he couldn't bring himself to burn his friend.

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk

lines.text: Because Gojo didn't lose to Kenjaku...

shot.fallback: anime style two young sorcerers in dark school uniforms at dusk
